build_skew_matrix: build a skew cross product matrix from a batch of 3-vectors using the skew function
build_se3_transform: build a 4x4 homogeneous transformation matrix from a rotation matrix and translation vector using rp_to_se3
compute_so3_exponential_map: compute the SO3 rotation matrix from a rotation axis and angle using Rodrigues formula via exp_so3
compute_se3_exponential_map: compute the SE3 homogeneous transformation from a 6D screw axis and motion magnitude using exp_se3
convert_homogeneous_coordinates: convert vectors to and from homogeneous coordinates using to_homogenous and from_homogenous functions
